column1: # One row per named round / arrow / ball / thrown object. `pon::catalog::get(id)`
# returns a fully-populated ProjectileType; the `klass` enum only seeds gaps and
# selects the code path — the string id *is* the round. A game loads its own
# CSV on top with pon::catalog::load_csv() (later ids override earlier).
#   drag_model            G1 | G7 | ConstantCd | BallProfile | CustomCurve
#   ballistic_coefficient scalar G1 or G7 BC (lb/in^2); use for G1/G7 rows
#   drag_coefficient      steady Cd; use for ConstantCd rows
#   ball_profile          id into ball_profiles.csv; use for BallProfile rows
#   hardness              relative core hardness (drives the deformation threshold)
#   spin_rate_radps       muzzle spin; 0 => derived from twist_rate_m * speed
